reason: It reads more careful than the usual agency pitch, I'll give them that. But it still means strangers sending cold messages to our distributors and buyers with our company name on them. In our industry everyone knows everyone, so one clumsy German email and the trade fair talks about it for a year. I'm not risking that on an agency I've never heard of.
objection: They say 'wholesalers, exporters, logistics', which is everyone. I don't see any proof they understand industrial buyers in my niche, and I don't see who has signed off on the GDPR side, or what happens to our reputation if a prospect complains.
would_change_my_mind: A reference call with a manufacturer or exporter like us who has run this with them for six months and still has a good name with their buyers, plus a written opinion on GDPR and the local rules from a real lawyer for the countries we sell into.
